FN-PS9HMEG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 268
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 268 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama 911 Board, paid
from the 911 Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to: (1) establish a system
to measure readiness of public safety services; (2) conduct audits and provide remediation plans
for certain local 911 districts; and (3) assume operational control of certain 911 districts to
implement remediation. The increased obligations incurred by the Board, while implementing a
remediation plan, could be offset, in whole or in part, by requesting reimbursement from the
local government entity that created the district, per the provisions of this bill.
In addition, the bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Office of the Attorney
General to comply with the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-PS9HMEG-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 268
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/28/2026
House Bill 268 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
increase the obligations of the Alabama 911 Board, paid from the 911 Fund, by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost to: (1) establish a system to measure readiness of public safety
services; (2) conduct performance audits of certain local 911 districts; and (3) provide and
supervise remediation plans for certain local 911 districts.
In addition, the bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Office of the Attorney
General to comply with the provisions of this bill.
